ValidationRule.description: Terminal chains are frozen as audit records (arch doc 8). PRIORVALUE lets the engine make the final transition INTO a terminal status; ISNEW keeps the rule off inserts. AMF_Bypass_Chain_Lock is the documented integration exception.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), NOT($Permission.AMF_Bypass_Chain_Lock), OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), 'Approved'), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), 'Rejected'), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), 'Recalled'), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), 'Failed') ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This approval chain has reached a terminal status and is locked as an audit record. Editing it requires the AMF Bypass Chain Lock permission.
